reason: isAsync middleware (pre(name, true, function (next, done))) is rejected by mongoose 8.16.1 TypeScript types as well (TS2769), so TS application code cannot use it without a cast, and its 9.x failure is the same missing next() as the pre-middleware-no-next task (mongoose-article-slug).

mongoose 8.16.1 types already reject find(null)/findOne(null)/countDocuments(null) (TS2769), so typed application code cannot rely on null meaning an empty filter; only an untyped value that happens to be null reaches it (unexpected input), and in 9 the error surfaces only at exec().
